description: Opt-in (PROTON_DRIVE_CONTENT_INDEX=1) encrypted local full-text index of file CONTENT in the folder you name; the key is kept in the OS keychain. action 'update' (default) indexes text, markdown, .docx and text-layer .pdf files two at a time, skips secret-looking names (.env, *.pem, *.key, id_rsa, names with password/secret/credential) and files over PROTON_DRIVE_READ_MAX_BYTES, and only re-reads changed files; if partial:true, call again to continue. 'status' reports counts, size, folders and key backend; 'clear' deletes the index file and its keychain key. Changes nothing on Drive; writes one local file.

path.description: Folder to index (required for update, e.g. /my-files/Documents). Never defaults to the whole drive.

timeBudgetMs.description: Stop starting new files after this long (default 25000).

name: drive_content_index
title: Manage content search index
